title: Why this 40-year market veteran is making a lonely bet on a 40% stock-market crash — and $500 oil
html:
Ulf Lindahl worries a Korea-like crash is coming for the S&P 500

Market veteran Ulf Lindahl is just as convinced that a 40% stock market crash is coming as he was before the October 1987 meltdown, as his proprietary momentum model had been raising the alarm.

“We happened to have a conference a few days before [the crash], and we’d already told them that we have a sell signal, and ‘If you want to go out and sell now, you shoud do that,’” Lindahl, the chief executive officer and founder of research and advisory firm Currency Research Associates, told MarketWatch in an interview on Thursday. He said none of those attendees did and “the next morning they woke up to the crash.”
summary: Ulf Lindahl says a storm is brewing for investors in the U.S. stock market, who will also be facing $500 oil in a few years. Here is where he’d shelter.
